# The "Groundhog Day" Problem {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

Stop repeating yourself

## Yesterday You Wrote a Perfect Delegation {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="problem" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
Your RICE prompt (RICE) nailed the tone, the format, the rules.

**It worked great.**
:::

## Next Week… {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="problem" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
New task. You open a fresh session. The agent has **amnesia** (the two layers).
:::

. . .

::: {.incremental}
- It doesn't know your role
- It doesn't know your tone or format rules
- You type the **Role** and **Context** all over again
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Productivity comes from **reuse**, not re-typing.
:::

# A Project = A Dedicated Office {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

One workspace per body of work

## The Office, Per Project {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="project" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
A **dedicated office (or folder)** for one body of work, with its own filing cabinet of
relevant documents — separate from your other work.
:::

. . .

The app pulls *that* project's pages onto the desk — **and not everything else.**

# The Wall Note {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

`CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`

## Standing Instructions {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="wall" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
The **note pinned to the office wall** that the brain reads at the **start of every job**:
who you are, your tone, your rules, your formats.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Two filenames, one idea
`CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` are the **same idea**. Other apps call it
*custom instructions* or a *system prompt*.
:::

## The Single Biggest Lever {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
Fix the tone, format, or a recurring rule here **once** — and it's fixed for **every**
future request.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
No re-typing. No reminding. This is the highest-return five minutes in the course.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Groundhog Day** — a one-off delegation dies when the session closes
2. **Project = a dedicated office** — the right files & rules, kept separate
3. **`CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`** — the wall note read at the start of every job
4. **The single biggest lever** — fix it once here, fixed forever
5. **Standing rules → `CLAUDE.md`; single-task details → one-off message**
:::
